## Release and security checklist

- [ ] No secret, private path, personal data, raw provider payload, benchmark source, or gold patch.
- [ ] Licensing and attribution were reviewed for new data, documentation, code, and assets.
- [ ] Research claims are traceable; negative results and exclusions are preserved.
